articles.summary: Discussions have emerged regarding young batting prospect Vaibhav Sooryavanshi following reports of his shortlisting for India's T20 tour of Ireland. Selection would place him among the youngest players ever named to a senior national squad.

articles.headline: World Cup-winning Indian Women’s Cricket Team Players To Be Presented The 2025 Tata Sierra
articles.summary: Members of the World Cup-winning Indian women's cricket team will be presented with new Tata Sierra vehicles to honor their historic championship performance. Tata Motors announced the reward to celebrate the squad's achievement on the global stage.

articles.headline: Pakistan can beat India in cricket only if Army Chief Asim Munir opens batting, ex-chief justice become um
articles.summary: Former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan publicly mocked the Pakistan Cricket Board following national team losses to India. Khan sarcastically remarked that Pakistan could only win if high-ranking political figures filled active team and officiating roles.

articles.headline: Threats, corruption and intimidation: Is the Bishnoi gang calling shots at Cricket Canada?
articles.summary: An investigative report by CBC outlines allegations of criminal gang intimidation targeting Cricket Canada officials. Canadian law enforcement is looking into governance concerns and safety threats surrounding organized cricket leagues.

articles.headline: Former Karnataka Cricketer Dies On Field After Suffering Heart Attack | Cricket News
articles.summary: A former Karnataka state cricketer died after suffering a cardiac arrest during a local match. Medical personnel provided immediate attention on the field, but he was declared deceased upon arrival at the hospital.
